method: Actual Google Colab browser UI; each notebook opened from the validated GitHub commit and executed on a newly allocated CPU runtime. Test runtimes disconnected and deleted after verification.
initial_setup: Enabled the supplied first-cell pip installation command; remaining cells executed in order with default settings. No Drive mount, IBM API key or repository checkout required.
limitations: Default simulation settings tested; IBM hardware execution not tested.
Additional edits from other active chats after the validated commit are not covered.
The first installation cell must be enabled before running all cells.
